task: Narrow the exact-match name exemption to deities and personified powers (David, approved)
rule: A source-tagged proper noun becomes 'X (name)' (non-content, no roots) unless its bare lemma both maps exactly to an inherited PIE lexeme (batch-6 gate) and is on the reviewed THEONYMS allowlist of deities and personified natural/abstract powers. PERSONAL_HOMOGRAPHS stays as a second guard (now redundant).

implementation.allowlist: pie/name_mapping.py THEONYMS (keys = production language normalizer, one justification each)
implementation.scope: Future builds and the search index only. Read slabs and committed Stage C-S results are unchanged.

method: Whole-corpus before/after over every token of the ten production loader populations, aligned by ordinal, locus and individual form; before = batch-6 gate (theonym_allowed forced True), after = production code. The census is every lemma name_lemma kept bare under the batch-6 gate. grp overlaps grc and is excluded from the aggregate.
reproduction: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pie-uv-cache uv run python -I scripts/audit_theonym_narrowing.py before DIR
UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pie-uv-cache uv run python -I scripts/audit_theonym_narrowing.py after DIR
UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pie-uv-cache uv run python -I scripts/audit_theonym_narrowing.py report DIR OUT.json

grc.ζεύς: Zeus, the Sky-father (*dyḗws); handbook (West 2007 ch. 4), project lexicon pie-lex-dyexws.
grc.δεύς: Δεύς, dialectal (Aeolic/Boeotian) form of Zeus; same Sky-father lexeme (pie-lex-dyexws).
grc.βορέας: Boreas, the North Wind as god (Hesiod Th. 379); a personified wind.
grc.εὖρος: Euros, the East Wind as power (Il. 2.145, Od. 5.295 wind catalogue).
grc.ἀΐδης: Hades, god of the dead (Il. 15.188); David's example, keep.
grc.ἀΐδας: Doric/lyric spelling of Hades, god of the dead.
grc.ἁίδας: Doric spelling of Hades, god of the dead.
grc.ἔρεβος: Erebos, personified primeval Darkness (Hesiod Th. 123); David's example, keep.
grc.ἥβη: Hebe, goddess and personified Youth (Il. 4.2; Hesiod Th. 922).
grc.ἠώς: Eos, the Dawn goddess (*h₂éwsōs); handbook (West 2007 ch. 5), pie-lex-h2ewsoxs.
grc.ὥρα: the Hours (Ὧραι), goddesses of the seasons (Il. 5.749; Hesiod Th. 901).
grc.φόβος: Phobos, personified Fear, companion of Ares (Il. 4.440, 13.299).
grc.χθών: Chthon, personified Earth as primeval power; pie-lex-dhegjhoxm.
grc.μήνη: Mene/Selene, the Moon as goddess (H. Herm. 99-100); pie-lex-mexh1ns.
grc.μήν: Men, the Anatolian Moon god (Strabo 12.3.31); pie-lex-mexh1ns.
grc.δίκη: Dike, goddess and personified Justice (Hesiod Th. 902, Op. 256).
grc.λήθη: Lethe, personified Oblivion (Hesiod Th. 227) and the mythic river of the dead.
grc.μνημοσύνη: Mnemosyne, Titaness and personified Memory (Hesiod Th. 54, 135).
grc.ὕπνος: Hypnos, personified Sleep (Il. 14.231; Hesiod Th. 212); pie-lex-supnos.
grc.ἕσπερος: Hesperos, the Evening Star as god (Il. 22.318); pie-lex-wekwsperos.
grc.τέρμων: Greek rendering of the Roman boundary god Terminus (Plut. Num. 16; Dion. Hal. 2.74).
grc.κόρος: Koros, personified Satiety, son of Hybris (Hdt. 8.77 oracle; Pind. O. 13.10).

la.auster: Auster, the South Wind as power.

la.liber: Liber, god of wine and fertility (Roman pantheon); source-tagged as a name.

orv.стрибогъ: Stribog, god of the winds (Primary Chronicle pantheon of 980).

Πόντος.reason: Largest borderline. Personified Sea exists (Hesiod Th. 132), but source-tagged Πόντος in these corpora is overwhelmingly the region Pontus / the Black Sea. Lowercase inherited πόντος is unaffected. Flag for David.

Νηρεύς.reason: Sea god, but the exact match is to *nér 'below', a speculative etymology, not the word for a power; root collocates would be false.

Τρίτων.reason: Sea god, but the exact match is to *tréyes 'three' (folk link via τρίτος); also a Libyan lake/river in geographers.

Ῥέα.reason: Titaness, but the exact match is to *h₁rṓs 'dew, moisture' (folk link to ῥέω); the name has no secure PIE etymology.

Σεμέλη.reason: Mortal mother of Dionysus, deified only later; half-deity, decided conservatively (match is earth *dʰéǵʰōm via the Thracian etymology).

Μαῖα.reason: Nymph, mother of Hermes; her name is the common noun 'mother, nurse', not a personified power.

Ἕως.reason: Attic dawn word, but the exact match is the conjunction ἕως 'until' (*Hyos): wrong lexeme.

Δίς.reason: Exact match is *dwis 'twice': wrong lexeme for any god (Zeus/Dis).

Δάν.reason: Biblical Dan; exact match *dweh₂m is a homograph.

Πατήρ.reason: Title/epithet ('Father'), not a theonym; treated like Latin pater/mater and Norse faðir.

Ἠριδανός.reason: Mythic river, matched to *déh₂nu 'river'; tokens are mostly the geographic river (Po). Rivers as geography get (name).

Στρυμών.reason: River; listed as a river god in Hesiod, but tokens are the geographic river.

Ῥᾶ.reason: River Rha (Volga) in geographers; match *h₁rṓs is a homograph.

Ταῦρος.reason: Mountain range / constellation / Tauri; not a deity.

Ἄρκτος.reason: The constellation Bear / the north; not a deity or personified power.

Κόρος.reason: Personified Satiety (Hdt. 8.77; Pind. O. 13.10); rare (1-3 tokens per corpus); could be a personal name.

Μήν.reason: Anatolian Moon god Men; the common noun μήν is lowercase and unaffected.

Λήθη.reason: Personified Oblivion; also the mythic river of the dead, still a mythic power.

Τέρμων.reason: Greek rendering of the Roman god Terminus.

hercules.reason: Deified hero (half-deity); decided conservatively. Its match is the iuvenis 'youth' family, not a power.

mater.reason: Title/epithet ('Mother', e.g. Magna Mater), not a theonym by itself.

dies.reason: One token; personified Day is marginal in Latin; likely an epithet or mistag.

lux.reason: One token; not a Roman deity.

septentrio.reason: The seven plough-oxen / north; constellation, not a deity.

liber.reason: The god Liber (source-tagged as a name); the common noun/adjective homographs are not name-tagged.

волосъ.reason: The god Volos, but the exact match is *h₂wĺ̥h₁ḱos 'wolf': wrong lexeme.

сѣверъ.reason: North / the Severiane tribe; not personified.

стрибогъ.reason: Wind god of the 980 pantheon; match *srew- 'flow' is the production exact route.

drottinn.reason: 'The Lord' as the name of God in religious texts; a deity reference whose root is its meaning.

andi.reason: The Holy Spirit (heilagr andi) in religious texts.

faðir.reason: Title ('Father') or kinship mistag; consistent with Greek Πατήρ, Latin pater.

himinn.reason: Heaven as a place in these texts; no personified Norse Sky god.

haf.reason: Sea as a place name/element; not personified.

sumar.reason: Season word name-tagged; not personified here.

ás.reason: IcePaHC Ás is ambiguous with the place/farm name 'ridge'; Menota áss 'god' keeps.

mars.reason: Match is horse/sea (*markos, *mori): wrong lexeme for Roman Mars.

gunnr.reason: Valkyrie name 'battle', but also a woman's name element; decided conservatively.

glámur.reason: Glámr is a revenant (draugr), not a deity.

álfur.reason: Personal name Álfr; elves are not individual deities.

askur.reason: Askr, the first man; not a deity.

gróa.reason: Gróa, a seeress (völva); human/mythic woman, not a deity.

hann.reason: Pronoun mis-tagged NPR; loses roots correctly (also þetta, ég, þú, þér, sá, vér, mér, hún, tveir).
